import pytest
from unittest.mock import MagicMock, AsyncMock
from svcs import Container, Registry

def test_mock_factory_get():
    registry = Registry()
    # A factory that returns a MagicMock
    # MagicMock will pass isinstance(mock, AbstractContextManager)
    mock_svc = MagicMock()
    registry.register_factory("MockSvc", lambda: mock_svc, enter=True)

    container = Container(registry)
    # This should NOT raise TypeError and should NOT attempt to call __enter__ on mock_svc
    # because it's a mock. It should just return mock_svc.
    svc = container.get("MockSvc")
    assert svc == mock_svc
    mock_svc.__enter__.assert_not_called()

@pytest.mark.asyncio
async def test_mock_factory_aget():
    registry = Registry()
    # A factory that returns an AsyncMock
    mock_svc = AsyncMock()
    registry.register_factory("MockSvc", lambda: mock_svc, enter=True)

    container = Container(registry)
    # This should NOT raise TypeError and should NOT attempt to await mock_svc
    # because it's an AsyncMock. It should just return mock_svc.
    svc = await container.aget("MockSvc")
    assert svc == mock_svc
    mock_svc.__aenter__.assert_not_called()
